title: Cargo workspace features code generation and proc macros
expected: Respect Cargo workspace and feature dependencies without YAML copies.
Capture build.rs source input; proc-macro execution stays inside the constrained toolchain context.

cases.name: mixed-registry
cases.change: Apply the Cargo-generated lock and core manifest/source overrides in variants/registry.
cases.expect: Build and verify all snapshot crates offline with captured itoa and unpublished local dependencies; retain reports, repeatable artifacts and unchanged inputs.

cases.name: incomplete-crate
cases.change: Exclude message.txt from the core crate in the mixed-registry variation.
cases.expect: Workspace compilation succeeds but native archive verification fails and no artifacts are collected.

cases.name: generated-input-change
cases.expect: Regenerate the constant and invalidate downstream consumers.

cases.name: doctest-failure
cases.change: Remove the negation from the greeting documentation assertion in core/src/lib.rs.
cases.expect: Native doctests fail while ordinary unit tests pass; retain a separate invocation-scoped JUnit failure and collect no artifacts.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
